1.text: Hahirwa abagenda batunganye,Bakagendera mu mategeko y'Uwiteka.

2.text: Hahirwa abitondera ibyo yahamije,Bakamushakisha umutima wose.

3.text: Ni koko nta cy'ubugoryi bakora,Bagendera mu nzira ze.

4.text: Wategekeye amategeko wigishije,Kugira ngo bayitondere n'umwete.

5.text: Icyampa inzira zanjye zigakomerera,Kwitondera amategeko wandikishije.

6.text: Ubwo nzita ku byo wategetse byose,Ni bwo ntazakorwa n'isoni.

7.text: Nzagushimisha umutima utunganye,Nimara kwiga amateka yawe yo gukiranuka.

9.text: Umusore azeza inzira ye ate?Azayejesha kuyitondera nk'uko ijambo ryawe ritegeka.

10.text: Nagushakishije umutima wose,Ntukunde ko nyoba ngo ndeke ibyo wategetse.

11.text: Nabikiye ijambo ryawe mu mutima wanjye,Kugira ngo ntagucumuraho.

12.text: Uwiteka, uri uwo guhimbazwa,Ujye unyigisha amategeko wandikishije.

13.text: Iminwa yanjye yatekerereje abantu,Amateka y'akanwa kawe yose.

14.text: Njya nishimira inzira y'ibyo wahamije,Ngo nyihwanye n'ubutunzi bwose.

15.text: Nzibwira amategeko wigishije,Kandi nzita ku nzira zawe.

17.text: Ugirire neza umugaragu wawe,Kugira ngo mbeho nitondere ijambo ryawe.

18.text: Hwejesha amaso yanjye,Kugira ngo ndebe ibitangaza byo mu mategeko yawe.

19.text: Ndi umusuhuke mu isi,Ntumpishe ibyo wategetse.

20.text: Umutima wanjye ushenguwe no kwifuza,Ujya wifuza amateka yawe ibihe byose.

21.text: Uhana abībone ari bo bivume,Byiyobagiza ibyo wategetse.

22.text: Unkureho umugayo n'igisuzuguriro,Kuko njya nitondera ibyo wahamije.

23.text: N'abakomeye bicaraga bamvuga nabi,Ariko umugaragu wawe nkibwira amategeko wandikishije.

24.text: Kandi nishimira ibyo wahamije,Ni byo bingīra inama.

25.text: Umutima wanjye womatanye n'umukungugu,Unzure nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

26.text: Nagutekerereje inzira zanjye uransubiza,Ujye unyigisha amategeko wandikishije.

27.text: Umenyeshe inzira y'amategeko wigishije,Kugira ngo nibwire imirimo itangaza wakoze.

28.text: Umutima wanjye urijijwe n'agahinda,Nkomeza nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

29.text: Unkureho inzira y'ibinyoma,Umpere amategeko yawe ubuntu.

30.text: Nahisemo inzira y'umurava,Nashyize amateka yawe imbere yanjye.

32.text: Nzagenda niruka mu nzira y'ibyo wategetse,Ubwo uzagūra umutima wanjye.

33.text: Uwiteka, ujye unyigisha inzira y'amategeko wandikishije:Kugira ngo nyitondere kugeza ku mperuka.

34.text: Umpe ubwenge, kugira ngo nitondere amategeko yawe;Nyitondereshe umutima wose.

35.text: Uncishe mu nzira y'ibyo wategetse,Kuko ari byo nishimira.

36.text: Uhindurire umutima wanjye ku byo wahamije,Ariko si ku ndamu mbi.

37.text: Ukebukishe amaso yanjye ye kureba ibitagira umumaro,Unzurire mu nzira zawe.

38.text: Ukomereze umugaragu wawe ijambo ryawe,Ryasezeranijwe abakubaha.

39.text: Unkureho umugayo ntinya,Kuko amateka yawe ari meza.

40.text: Dore njya nifuza amategeko wigishije,Unzure ku bwo gukiranuka kwawe.

41.text: Uwiteka, imbabazi zawe zingereho,Ni zo gakiza kawe nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

42.text: Ni ho nzabona icyo mbwira untutse,Kuko niringira ijambo ryawe.

43.text: Kandi ntukure rwose ijambo ry'ukuri mu kanwa kanjye,Kuko njya niringira kubona amateka yawe.

44.text: Ni ho nzajya nitondera amategeko yawe,Ubudasiba iteka ryose.

45.text: Kandi nzagendana umudendezo,Kuko njya ndondora amategeko wigishije.

46.text: Nzavugira imbere y'abami ibyo wahamije,Ne gukorwa n'isoni.

48.text: Kandi nzamanikira amaboko ibyo wategetse, ndabikunda,Kandi nzibwira amategeko wandikishije.

49.text: Wibuke ijambo wasezeranije umugaragu wawe,Kuko wanyiringije.

50.text: Iki ni cyo kimara umubabaro mu makuba yanjye no mu byago byanjye,Ni uko ijambo ryawe ryanzuye.

51.text: Abibone bajya bankoba cyane,Ariko sinteshuke ngo mve mu mategeko yawe.

52.text: Uwiteka, njya nibuka amateka yawe ya kera,Nkīmara umubabaro.

53.text: Uburakari bwotsa buramfashe,Ntewe n'abanyabyaha bareka amategeko yawe.

54.text: Amategeko wandikishije abereye indirimbo zanjye,Mu nzu y'ubusuhuke bwanjye.

55.text: Uwiteka, njya nibuka izina ryawe nijoro,Nkitondera amategeko yawe.

56.text: Iki ni cyo nahawe:Ni ukwitondera amategeko wigishije.

57.text: Uwiteka ni we mugabane wanjye,Navuze yuko nzitondera amagambo yawe.

58.text: Njya ngushakisha umutima wose kundebana urukundo,Umbabarire, nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

59.text: Njya ntekereza inzira zanjye,Ngahindurira ibirenge byanjye ku byo wahamije.

61.text: Ikigoyi cy'abanyabyaha kirambohaboshye,Ariko sinibagirwa amategeko yawe.

62.text: Mu gicuku nzakanguka ngushimire,Amateka yawe yo gukiranuka.

64.text: Uwiteka, isi yuzuye imbabazi zawe,Ujye unyigisha amategeko wandikishije.

65.text: Uwiteka, wagiriye neza umugaragu wawe,Nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

66.text: Ujye unyigisha guhitamo neza no kumenya ubwenge,Kuko nizera amategeko yawe.

67.text: Ntarababazwa narayobaga,Ariko none nitondera ijambo ryawe.

68.text: Uri mwiza kandi ugira neza,Ujye unyigisha amategeko wandikishije.

69.text: Abibone bajya bandemera ibinyoma,Ariko jyeweho nzitonderesha amategeko yawe umutima wanjye wose.

70.text: Imitima yabo ihonjotse nk'ibinure,Ariko jyeweho nishimira amategeko yawe.

71.text: Kubabazwa kwangiriye umumaro,Kugira ngo nige amategeko wandikishije.

72.text: Amategeko yo mu kanwa kawe ni ay'igiciro kuri jye,Kiruta icy'ibice ibihumbi by'ifeza n'izahabu.

73.text: Intoki zawe ni zo zandemye, ni zo zambumbye,Umpe ubwenge kugira ngo nige ibyo wategetse.

74.text: Abakūbaha bazandeba bishime,Kuko niringira ijambo ryawe.

75.text: Uwiteka, nzi yuko amateka yawe ari ayo gukiranuka,Kandi yuko umurava ari wo waguteye kuncisha bugufi.

76.text: Ndakwinginze, imbabazi zawe zimare umubabaro,Nk'uko ijambo ryawe riri wasezeranije umugaragu wawe.

77.text: Ibambe ryawe ringereho kugira ngo mbeho,Kuko amategeko yawe ari yo munezero wanjye.

78.text: Abībone bakorwe n'isoni,Kuko bandenganishije ibinyoma,Ariko jyeweho nzajya nibwira amategeko yawe.

79.text: Abakūbaha bampindukirire,Kugira ngo bamenye ibyo wahamije.

80.text: Umutima wanjye utungane mu mategeko wandikishije,Kugira ngo ne gukorwa n'isoni.

81.text: Umutima wanjye ugushwa isari no kwifuza agakiza kawe,Ariko niringira ijambo ryawe.

82.text: Amaso yanjye amarwa no kwifuza ijambo ryawe,Nkivuga nti “Uzamara umubabaro ryari?”

83.text: Kuko mpindutse nk'imvumba y'uruhu iba ku mwotsi,Ariko sinibagirwe amategeko wandikishije.

84.text: Iminsi y'ubugingo bw'umugaragu wawe ni ingahe?Uzasohoza ryari iteka ku bangenza?

86.text: Ibyo wategetse byose ni umurava,Bangenjesha ibinyoma, ntabara.

87.text: Bashigaje hato bakandimbura mu isi,Ariko sinareka amategeko wigishije.

88.text: Unzure nk'uko imbabazi zawe ziri,Kugira ngo nitondere ibyo akanwa kawe kahamije.

89.text: Uwiteka, iteka ryose,Ijambo ryawe rihora mu ijuru rihamye.

90.text: Umurava wawe uhoraho ibihe byose,Wakomeje isi igumaho.

91.text: Amategeko yawe ni yo atuma byose bibaho uyu munsi,Kuko byose bigukorera.

92.text: Iyaba amategeko yawe atari yo munezero wanjye,Cya gihe mba nararimbuwe n'umubabaro wanjye.

93.text: Ntabwo nzibagirwa amategeko wigishije,Kuko ari yo wanzurishije.

94.text: Ndi uwawe nkiza,Kuko ndondora amategeko wigishije.

95.text: Abanyabyaha bajya bantegerereza kundimbura,Ariko nzita ku byo wahamije.

96.text: Narebye yuko ibitunganye rwose byose bifite aho bigarukira,Ariko amategeko yawe ni magari cyane.

97.text: Amategeko yawe nyakunda ubu bugeni,Ni yo nibwira umunsi ukīra.

98.text: Ibyo wategetse bituma ndusha abanzi banjye ubwenge,Kuko bihorana nanjye iteka.

99.text: Mfite ubwenge buruta ubw'abigisha banjye bose,Kuko ibyo wahamije ari ibyo nibwira.

100.text: Ndajijuka nkarusha abasaza,Kuko njya nitondera amategeko wigishije.

101.text: Njya ndinda ibirenge byanjye inzira mbi zose,Kugira ngo nitondere ijambo ryawe.

102.text: Simva mu mateka yawe,Kuko ari wowe wanyigishije.

103.text: Amagambo yawe aryohereye ubu bugeni mu nkanka zanjye,Arusha ubuki kuryohera mu kanwa kanjye.

104.text: Amategeko wigishije ampesha guhitamo,Ni cyo gituma nanga inzira z'ibinyoma zose.

105.text: Ijambo ryawe ni itabaza ry'ibirenge byanjye,Ni umucyo umurikira inzira yanjye.

106.text: Nararahiye ndabikomeza,Yuko nzitondera amateka yawe yo gukiranuka.

107.text: Ndababazwa cyane,Uwiteka, unzure nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

108.text: Uwiteka ndakwinginze,Wemere amaturo y'akanwa kanjye ava mu rukundo,Kandi ujye unyigisha amateka yawe.

109.text: Ubugingo bwanjye buri mu kaga iteka,Ariko sinibagirwa amategeko yawe.

110.text: Abanyabyaha bajya bantega ikigoyi,Ariko sinyobe amategeko wigishije.

111.text: Ibyo wahamije nabyendeye kuba umwandu wanjye iteka,Kuko ari byo byishimo by'umutima wanjye.

112.text: Nshyize umutima wanjye ku gusohoza amategeko yawe,Iteka ryose kugeza ku mperuka.

113.text: Nanga ab'imitima ibiri,Ariko amategeko yawe ndayakunda.

114.text: Ni wowe bwihisho bwanjye n'ingabo inkingira,Niringira ijambo ryawe.

115.text: Mwa nkozi z'ibibi mwe, nimuve aho ndi,Kugira ngo nitondere ibyo Imana yanjye yategetse.

116.text: Umbere ubwishingikirizo nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije,Kugira ngo mbeho ne kuzakozwa isoni n'ibyiringiro byanjye.

117.text: Undamire nzaba mu mahoro,Njye nitondera amategeko wandikishije.

118.text: Wasuzuguye abiyobagiza bose amategeko wandikishije,Kuko uburiganya bwabo ari ibinyoma.

119.text: Ukuraho abanyabyaha bo mu isi bose nk'inkamba,Ni cyo gituma nkunda ibyo wahamije.

120.text: Umubiri wanjye uhindishwa umushyitsi no kugutinya,Kandi ntinya amateka yawe.

121.text: Njya nkora ibihūra n'amateka n'ibyo gukiranuka,Ntundekere abampata.

122.text: Wigwatirize yuko uzagirira neza umugaragu wawe,Abībone be kumpata.

123.text: Amaso yanjye amarwa no kwifuza agakiza kawe,N'ijambo ryawe ryo gukiranuka.

124.text: Ujye ugirira umugaragu wawe ibihwanye n'imbabazi zawe,Kandi unyigishe amategeko wandikishije.

125.text: Ndi umugaragu wawe umpe ubwenge,Kugira ngo menye ibyo wahamije.

126.text: Igihe gikwiriye cyo gukora k'Uwiteka kirasohoye,Kuko bahinduye ubusa amategeko yawe.

127.text: Ni cyo gituma nkunda ibyo wategetse,Nkabirutisha izahabu naho yaba izahabu nziza.

128.text: Ni cyo gituma nibwira yuko amategeko wigishije yose atunganye,Kandi nanga inzira z'ibinyoma zose.

129.text: Ibyo wahamije ni ibitangaza,Ni cyo gituma umutima wanjye ubyitondera.

130.text: Guhishurirwa amagambo yawe kuzana umucyo,Guha abaswa ubwenge.

131.text: Nasama akanwa nkahagira,Kuko nifuza amategeko yawe.

132.text: Unkebuke umbabarire,Nk'uko umenyereye kubabarira abakunda izina ryawe.

133.text: Ujye utunganya intambwe zanjye mu ijambo ryawe,Gukiranirwa kose kwe kuntegeka.

134.text: Uncungure ne guhatwa n'abantu,Kugira ngo nitondere amategeko wigishije.

135.text: Umurikishirize umugaragu wawe mu maso hawe,Unyigishe amategeko wandikishije.

136.text: Amaso yanjye atembyemo imigezi y'amazi,Kuko batitondera amategeko yawe.

139.text: Ishyaka ryanjye rirandimbuye,Kuko abanzi banjye bibagiwe amagambo yawe.

140.text: Ijambo ryawe ryaravugutiwe cyane,Ni cyo gituma umugaragu wawe ndikunda.

142.text: Gukiranuka kwawe ni ugukiranuka kw'iteka ryose,Amategeko yawe ni ukuri.

143.text: Agahinda n'umubabaro biranteye,Ariko, ibyo wategetse ni byo munezero wanjye.

144.text: Ibyo wahamije ni ibyo gukiranuka iteka ryose,Umpe ubwenge kugira ngo mbeho.

145.text: Ntakishije umutima wose, Uwiteka nsubiza,Nzitondera amategeko wandikishije.

146.text: Ndagutakiye nkiza,Kugira ngo nitondere ibyo wahamije.

147.text: Njya nzinduka umuseke utaratambika ngataka,Amagambo yawe ni yo niringira.

148.text: Amaso yanjye abanziriza ibicuku,Kugira ngo nibwire ijambo ryawe.

149.text: Umva ijwi ryanjye nk'uko imbabazi zawe ziri,Uwiteka, unzure nk'uko iteka ryawe riri.

150.text: Abangenjesha igomwa baregereye,Bishyize kure y'amategeko yawe.

151.text: Uwiteka, uri bugufi,Ibyo wategetse byose ni ukuri.

152.text: Uhereye kera namenyeshejwe n'ibyo wahamije,Yuko wabikomeje iteka ryose.

153.text: Ita ku mubabaro wanjye unkize,Kuko ntibagirwa amategeko yawe.

154.text: Umburanire uncungure,Unzure nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

155.text: Agakiza kari kure y'abanyabyaha,Kuko batarondora amategeko wandikishije.

156.text: Uwiteka, imbabazi zawe zirakomeye,Unzure nk'uko amateka yawe ari.

157.text: Abangenza n'abanzi banjye ni benshi,Ariko sinteshuka ngo mve mu byo wahamije.

158.text: Nabonye abava mu isezerano ndabīnuba,Kuko batitondera ijambo ryawe.

159.text: Ita ku rukundo nkunda amategeko wigishije,Uwiteka, unzure nk'uko imbabazi zawe ziri.

160.text: Indunduro y'ijambo ryawe ryose ni ukuri,Amateka yawe yo gukiranuka ahoraho iteka ryose hadasigaye na rimwe.

161.text: Abakomeye bajya bangenzereza ubusa,Ariko amagambo yawe ni yo ahindisha umushyitsi umutima wanjye.

163.text: Nanga ibinyoma, mbyanga urunuka,Ariko amategeko yawe ndayakunda.

164.text: Uko bukeye ngushimira karindwi,Amateka yawe yo gukiranuka.

165.text: Abakunda amategeko yawe bagira amahoro menshi,Nta kigusha bafite.

166.text: Uwiteka, njya niringira agakiza kawe,Kandi ngakora ibyo wategetse.

167.text: Umutima wanjye ujya witondera ibyo wahamije,Kandi mbikunda rwose.

168.text: Njya nitondera amategeko wigishije n'ibyo wahamije,Kuko inzira zawe zose ziri imbere yawe.

169.text: Uwiteka, gutaka kwanjye kukwegere,Umpe ubwenge nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

170.text: Kwinginga kwanjye kujye imbere yawe,Unkize nk'uko ijambo ryawe ryasezeranije.

171.text: Iminwa yanjye ivuge ishimwe,Kuko unyigisha amategeko wandikishije.

172.text: Ururimi rwanjye ruririmbe ijambo ryawe,Kuko ibyo wategetse byose ari ibyo gukiranuka.

173.text: Ukuboko kwawe kube kwiteguye kuntabara,Kuko nahisemo amategeko wigishije.

174.text: Uwiteka, njya nifuza agakiza kawe,Kandi amategeko yawe ni yo munezero wanjye.

175.text: Umutima wanjye ubeho kugira ngo ugushime,Amateka yawe antabare.

176.text: Nayobye nk'intama izimiye,Shaka umugaragu wawe,Kuko ntibagirwa amategeko yawe.
